tools.name: qr_suisse_search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search in the QR Suisse documentation (English): overview (llms.txt), instructions for agents, API authentication, pricing and one page per operation of the QR Suisse REST API v1. Returns up to 5 pages, best match first.

tools.name: qr_suisse_get_page
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown text of one page of the QR Suisse documentation (English), from a closed list: llms-txt, agents-md, auth-md, pricing-md, or api/<operationId> for an operation of the QR Suisse REST API v1.
